hypothesis: Compile ordinary generic function definitions through existing DefineFunction/InternFunction; retain CreateTypeScope after defaults, attach metadata and bind compiled functions to its existing closure. Capture enclosing executable cells from original context first. Existing LoadName resolves type-parameter namespaces; no new cell type or lookup framework.
removal: Delete unconditional generic statement-fallback emission and unconditional generic/type-scope lowered-definition route only where an existing ordinary CodeObject suffices. Retain generator/contextual fallback consumers.
acceptance: Pin6 CPython cases under both APIs before edits. Source-level: generic ordinary function body and nested ordinary helper stay executable, metadata/lazy annotations and enclosing live cells stay correct. Existing modern typing/delayed-host/fuel/stack/owner/refusal tests and58 complete jobs. Only after source/correctness gate, one short native comparison with unchanged non-generic controls; no retiming or predicted speedup.
stopping: Only normal generic functions with executable bodies, using existing TypeScope and cell capture. No class-layout/generator/alias redesign, new lookup/cell protocol or frontend representation inventory. Stop/reassess if these existing mechanisms cannot preserve live captures. This is a hypothesis; deleting branches alone is invalid.
